notes: Audited every core mechanic against the wiki after the shield fix and found a second one: nothing enforced the game 0.1s cooldown floor, so CDS-stacked carries cast faster in the sim than the game allows - the Boomagon chain was overrated. The Board-vs-Master baseline is rebuilt with the corrected engine and the 0.8.5 balance (it was being compared against numbers from a different engine), and the patch overrides now apply in the Node tools as well as the browser, from one shared implementation.
